description: Literal one-hour scoring rules for the ACTIVSg2000 dispatch game. The AI-intensive IT-service value is an explicit full-horizon profile. Scored energy purchases settle against LMPs from the joint dispatch; these are instructional model outputs, not an official ERCOT market-price forecast.

storage_cost_provenance.currency_year: 2022 USD for capital benchmarks; nominal instructional coefficients
storage_cost_provenance.basis: rounded 2028 moderate four-hour projection from NREL's 2023 utility-scale battery cost update
storage_cost_provenance.evaluator_mapping: Storage operating cost is not charged.

it_value_provenance.source_note: Rounded from a recent AI-compute willingness-to-pay estimate with a blended value near $6,350/MWh; cloud VM prices remain contextual rather than a direct tariff conversion.

economic_profile_artifact.settlement_basis: LMP from the selected joint dispatch at the selected bus
